cells.scene: A car dashboard viewed from the front seats with speedometer, fuel gauge, steering wheel and simple controls; no legible brand.
A laughing adult reveals that a supposed precious gift is an empty cardboard box while their friend looks surprised; harmless deception clearly uncovered.
A seller displays a fake jewel as valuable while concealing a pile of identical cheap glass beads beneath the counter.
An adult calmly refuses an insulting offer, straight posture and firm gentle raised palm, other person holding a paltry coin.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — dashboard (n.(汽车上的)仪表盘): A car dashboard viewed from the front seats with speedometer, fuel gauge, steering wheel and simple controls; no legible brand.
TOP RIGHT — hoax (n.骗局，戏弄): A laughing adult reveals that a supposed precious gift is an empty cardboard box while their friend looks surprised; harmless deception clearly uncovered.
BOTTOM LEFT — deception (n.欺骗，骗局): A seller displays a fake jewel as valuable while concealing a pile of identical cheap glass beads beneath the counter.
BOTTOM RIGHT — self-respecting (a.自重的，自尊的): An adult calmly refuses an insulting offer, straight posture and firm gentle raised palm, other person holding a paltry coin.
EXTRA CROP SAFETY: Draw noticeably SMALLER compact subjects. Every object, mast, roof, thought bubble and entire person must have an empty white border of at least 12% of its quadrant on ALL FOUR sides. Top row ends above 44% canvas height; bottom row starts below 58%. Never let a background tower extend upward into the midline. No part is clipped by a quadrant edge.
review_notes: All cells passed meaning, anatomy and quadrant crop review. Self-respecting shows rejecting a bribe; indulge depicts enjoying treats; pneumatic includes a visible air hose connected to a compressor; drill has a coherent drill bit and handheld body.
